title: Retention
description: How long meeting records and transcript segments are kept. Each default is the value the stack was deployed with, and is also the longest this deployment allows: a shorter period can be set here, a longer one cannot. Recordings in the recordings bucket, and the bucket's lifecycle rules, follow the stack parameters only.
appliesText: A saved change applies within about five minutes, to records written after that. A record already written keeps the expiry it was given.

meetingRecordExpirationInDays.title: Days to keep meeting records
meetingRecordExpirationInDays.description: How long a meeting, its summary and its usage records are kept after each is written; fractions of a day are allowed. At most the MeetingRecordExpirationInDays stack parameter, which is also the default.

transcriptionExpirationInDays.title: Days to keep transcript segments
transcriptionExpirationInDays.description: How long each turn of a meeting's transcript, and each meeting assistant answer in it, is kept after it is written; fractions of a day are allowed. At most the TranscriptionExpirationInDays stack parameter, which is also the default.
